findings.finding: A large apparent range can coincide with abnormal spread expansion. Spread state must be separated from true directional shock.
findings.required_fix: Enumerate NONE and causal spread-percentile/absolute-spread filters; never create artificial fills from zero spread.

findings.finding: Repeated adjacent shock bars may represent one event rather than independent entries.
findings.required_fix: Enumerate event refractory windows and consolidate overlapping shock bars into one event identity before scoring.

findings.finding: Canonical tick streams allow distinguishing price shock with/without abnormal quote intensity without requiring external volume.
findings.required_fix: Add optional causal tick-count intensity context as a descendant; keep NONE baseline.

findings.finding: A large true range after a data gap or market reopening must not be silently treated as ordinary intraday shock.
findings.required_fix: Freeze bar-continuity/gap flags and include NONE/EXCLUDE_DATA_GAP/REOPENING_SEPARATE_EVENT policies before mining.

findings.finding: The discovery identity is first executable quote after close; latency variants belong to stress validation, not alpha mining.
findings.required_fix: Freeze zero additional discovery latency and preregister latency stress buckets.
